text: 据知情人士透露，巴西铁矿石巨头淡水河谷考虑首次在中国境内市场发债，融资不超过35亿元人民币，加入越来越多寻求分散融资来源并降低融资成本的发行人行列。 该公司计划在10月19日当周为发行“熊猫债”举行路演，并争取最快11月开始发行推介。债券期限可能为3年、5年或10年，最终期限将根据投资者反馈确定。这批熊猫债将由淡水河谷旗下Vale Overseas Limited发行，并由母公司提供担保。（彭博
text_en: According to people familiar with the matter, Brazilian iron ore giant Vale is considering issuing bonds in China's domestic market for the first time, raising no more than 3.5 billion yuan, joining a growing number of issuers seeking to diversify funding sources and reduce financing costs. The company plans to hold a roadshow for the "panda bond" issuance in the week of October 19 and aims to begin issuance marketing as early as November. The bond tenor may be 3, 5 or 10 years, with the final tenor to be determined based on investor feedback. The panda bonds will be issued by Vale's subsidiary Vale Overseas Limited and guaranteed by the parent company. (Bloomberg
